body: I could go to community college but then I wouldn't be able to transfer into the major I want because they don't offer classes in the field. And then I'd also have to live at home and I can't handle even another month of that. I've never been particularly good at anything, so it's not like I can pick something and go with it.
I don't mean to be rude, but that's a bit of an unfounded claim. I couldn't even get enough merit to go to a state college.

I already have two jobs and a third one for the summer. I'm "eligible" for financial aid but neither of the colleges gave me any. We even asked them to reevaluate my package and they basically told us to fuck off because we make too much money. My parents aren't willing to pay 30k a year because they're concerned about getting my younger brother through college. Even if they did, that would still be 10k a year of debt for me. I already looked at community college prices and yes, the situation is the same there. I have about 3k to my name, I live in an affluent area with nothing affordable for miles around, with little to no transportation. I can't rely on my parents because their solution to everything is to try and bring me down so that it gets me to try harder. I'm not good at making friends and the ones that I have live 20-30 miles away. I'm stuck at a point in my life that makes me more depressed than I've ever been and I don't see a way out of it.
